title: ERC-8004 core objects
caption: The objects of the Draft text and how they refer to each other. The registration file and the feedback file are off-chain JSON; the other classes are contract storage or events. Field names follow the text of 2026-01-25.
alt: Class diagram. AgentIdentity has agentId, owner, agentURI and metadata. RegistrationFile has type, name, description, image, services, x402Support, active, registrations and supportedTrust. Service has name, endpoint, version, skills, domains. Registration has agentId and agentRegistry. MetadataEntry has metadataKey and metadataValue. FeedbackRecord has value, valueDecimals, tag1, tag2 and isRevoked, keyed by client and feedbackIndex. FeedbackFile has agentRegistry, agentId, clientAddress, createdAt, value, valueDecimals and optional proofOfPayment. ProofOfPayment has fromAddress, toAddress, chainId and txHash. ValidationRecord has requestHash, validatorAddress, agentId, response, responseHash, tag and lastUpdate.
